  only in A, modified 2026-10-01 05:00

  url      https://mail.work.example
  [k] keep  [d] drop   Enter = keep
choice> ?
  a  take A's version          b  take B's version
  t  keep both (B's copy gets a new UUID)
  k  keep it                   d  drop it
  Enter  the choice shown (the default)   v  show the password, notes and custom fields that differ
  p  go back                   r  apply a rule to this and all the remaining changes
  q  quit; nothing is written
